live_acceptance: Provide an authorized native-saved control and asymmetric partial-capo fixture from the same minimal six-string score. Use partial fret 3 on named strings 1 and 4. Give each string one identifiable open note. Record application version, hashes, UI values and experimental seed provenance. State the actual authoring version within the shared GP7/GP8 GPIF family.

Provide a native combined-capo variant with whole capo 2 and partial absolute fret 5. Record exact wire offsets and native MIDI pitches. Record the native response to a partial fret less than the whole capo. If the application refuses that value, provide its refusal and a zero-offset control instead of an invented valid fixture.

Record exact GPIF PartialCapoFret and PartialCapoStringFlags fields. Use controlled single-string siblings to establish flag order independently from tuning reversal. Retain the named native UI labels and corresponding MIDI pitches.

Run public Go ParseWithOptions and pinned AlphaTab on every valid fixture. Record source fields, diagnostic paths and parser settings. Keep native Guitar Pro results separate because the pinned reference does not retain partial capo.

Deliver the fixtures and machine-readable receipts in the corpus and database. Define the mapping and public edit contract only after native facts establish them. Keep acquisition evidence separate from implementation tests and support ratings. Review the exact final commit before closure.
results: PASS: Seven native-saved source fixtures include the control, strings 1 and 4 at partial fret 3, exact UI values, hashes and transparent XML-seed provenance. Native application: Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build 31.
PASS: Whole capo 2 plus partial absolute 5 yields wire offset 3 and native pitches [69,61,57,55,47,42]. Native refusal of below-whole input and accepted zero-offset control are recorded.
PASS: Independent single-string siblings establish high-first public order and reversed wire bits; UI labels and native MIDI pitches agree.
PASS: Every valid source has public Go and pinned AlphaTab receipts. Native playback is separate; AlphaTab discards the partial capo.

PASS: Corpus fixtures, database, native receipts, public API, parser, exporter, edit contract and regression tests are committed. Exact final source matches independent review hashes; the prescribed full gate passes.
